Conversation field guide · 2–13 July 2026

Three small shifts
for clearer English

Across the 12 supplied sessions, three error patterns recur in at least three sessions each. Focus on marking finished events, counting things with uncountable nouns, and putting questions inside other sentences.

These are targeted observations, not an overall accuracy score. Choose any focus; the short applications are optional.

Use one distinction in your next conversation—or simply keep it in mind. No practice is required.
